definitions.energy: EU labelling factors: protein 4, available carbohydrate (excluding polyols) 4, fat 9, alcohol 7, organic acids 3, polyols 2.4, oligosaccharides 2, fibre 2 kcal/g (always calculated)
definitions.protein: Total nitrogen x 6.25 for every food
definitions.carbohydrate: Available carbohydrate by weight: sugars + starch + available oligosaccharides + polyols (not by difference; excludes fibre)
definitions.fibre: Total dietary fibre (high and low molecular weight, partly calculated)
definitions.vitaminA: Retinol equivalents: retinol + beta-carotene / 6 + other carotenoids / 12 (the UK and EU definition; US targets use retinol activity equivalents)
definitions.vitaminK: Phylloquinone (vitamin K1) only; BLS also gives K2, which isn't counted here, as for the other tables
definitions.niacinNE: Niacin equivalents as published by BLS (niacin + tryptophan / 60)
definitions.folate: Dietary folate equivalents: food folate + 1.7 x synthetic folic acid (the US and EU definition; UK targets use total folate)

labels.s: BLS: rescaling (from another state of the food)
labels.d: BLS: taken from another food composition database
labels.lodloq: below the limit of detection or quantification
labels.z: BLS: logical zero (assumed not to occur in this food; not a measurement)
labels.err: BLS erratum (August 2026): corrected value, in force until BLS 4.1
labels.errna: BLS erratum (August 2026): this value is wrong in BLS 4.0 and its correction is not yet published, so it is not available
labels.erren: BLS erratum (August 2026): energy recalculated without the oligosaccharides BLS 4.0 counted twice (published value - 2 kcal per g of oligosaccharides)
labels.erraa: BLS erratum (August 2026): a zero amino acid in a food with protein may be a rounding or transfer error (under review for BLS 4.1), so it is not available
